Indian envoy advises Pakistan against aligning with China

India's envoy to the UN, Ruchira Kamboj, stated that Pakistan does not need to become a "tail-wagger" of China. She advised Pakistan to adopt a policy similar to China's, suggesting it would be more beneficial than aligning with Beijing. The remarks were made in the context of Pakistan's economic situation and its relationship with China.
